description: Heritage `value of … for key` on a WORD container raises the byte-identical Core `ol-type` the dotted `:w.tom` selector raises — `expected: "dict"`, `operation: "field"` (`spec/conformance.md:146`: alternate spellings only, no new semantics). One of the container-type fixtures issue #784 added so the corpus enumerates the non-dict types instead of sampling one: the defect it fixed was coherent for `word` and incoherent for `list`, so any corpus that tests some types and not others can hide the next one of its kind. NO Heritage spelling in any payload (`operation` is the Core `"field"`, never `"value of"` — issue #670). The span points at the reader's `:w` operand (localization-only difference — `spec/localization.md`). Heritage depends on Data (`spec/conformance.md:301`), so both `data` and `heritage` are active.
